create.title: Part I: First Dutch
create.summary: Your first Dutch: greetings, introducing yourself, where you're from and where you live, languages, numbers and your age, family, de or het, and simple descriptions. Zijn and hebben, the present tense (singular), niet and geen, and your first adjectives.
create.intendedLearner: Complete beginners. No Dutch needed. Explanations are in English, and every new word is glossed. Leads into Part II.
